beats.text: Seven times hotter? That is not a number.
beats.scene: Painted roaring Babylonian brick kiln at night, orange glow, camera pushing in. Overlay: crossed-out x7.

beats.text: King Nebuchadnezzar orders the furnace heated seven times.
beats.scene: King pointing at a glowing furnace in the courtyard at dusk. Overlay: counter x7.

beats.text: Babylonian kilns fired bricks at about nine hundred to a thousand degrees.
beats.scene: Workers stacking baked bricks beside a glowing kiln. Overlay: temperature counter 900-1000 C.

beats.text: Your home oven tops out around two hundred fifty.
beats.scene: Close-up of a home oven glowing orange. Overlay: temperature counter 250 C.

beats.text: Seven times nine hundred is six thousand three hundred degrees.
beats.scene: Fire column rising from a pit, sparks against a dark sky. Overlay: counter 6,300 C.

beats.text: The Sun's surface is only about fifty-five hundred.
beats.scene: Setting sun behind the kiln smoke. Overlay: compare 6,300 C vs 5,500 C.

beats.text: So 'seven times' is an idiom for the maximum.
beats.scene: Scribe ticking seven marks on clay. Overlay: ratio badge 7 = full.

beats.text: The strongest soldiers bound three men and threw them in.
beats.scene: Three bound men beside the furnace, soldiers heaving ropes. Overlay: counter 3.

beats.text: The flames killed the soldiers at the opening.
beats.scene: Soldiers collapsing at a fiery furnace mouth, heat haze. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Then the king saw four men walking in the fire, unharmed.
beats.scene: Kiln cross-section with a top hatch glowing. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Not proven: no Babylonian record mentions the event.
beats.scene: Cuneiform tablet in dim light with a flickering shadow. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: So 'seven times hotter': literal, or idiom?
beats.scene: Furnace glow with three silhouettes standing inside, slow push. Overlay: choice tags A literal / B idiom.

youtube.title: Seven Times Hotter? The Furnace of Daniel 3 #shorts
youtube.description:
Daniel 3 says the furnace was heated seven times hotter. What does the text, and a real Babylonian kiln, tell us?
No Babylonian record of this event has been found.
#Daniel #Bible #Babylon #BibleHistory
